about:
Shot list on the film clock (30 fps). Every shot is a real camera key: part a from parts/a/path.js CAMS, b-j from parts/

/reel.js direct (camsrc). Size from camera distance and lens, angle from pitch. Scenes = parts.

scenes.feel: warmth that drops into shock: the one you hold is gone mid-cheer
scenes.key: at midnight every woman and girl vanished
scenes.question: what happens to the men left?

scenes.feel: panic that turns into a tender catch
scenes.key: only boys are left; the boy born at 23:59 is the one to remember
scenes.question: who is this boy?

scenes.feel: an ache: an old love set at an empty chair
scenes.key: elder care was women's work; the frail feel it first
scenes.question: who looks after the old?

scenes.key: every family lost its mothers, wives, daughters
scenes.question: how do they say goodbye?

scenes.feel: alarm alone on an empty floor
scenes.question: can the world keep running?

scenes.key: scarcity makes men fight; some let go
scenes.question: who gets the last tin?

scenes.key: all the care work is now on the men
scenes.question: can he hold on?

scenes.key: no one has ever built a womb
scenes.question: can science save them?

scenes.key: the youngest person on Earth turns 80; nobody after
scenes.question: who is left?

scenes.feel: calm love and peace at the very end
scenes.key: the boy of 23:59 is the last person; she held him for one minute
scenes.question: did he remember her?

scenes.feel: the ask: send this to the woman who held you first
scenes.key: no women, no one after us
scenes.question: who held you first?
scenes.noEst: the end card has no place
